claim: E-commerce accounts for 69% of all digital accessibility lawsuits; food service is second at 18%; healthcare is 4% and rising fast
value_specific: H1 2025 (UsableNet midyear): E-commerce 69%, Food Services 18%, Healthcare 4%, Fitness & Wellness 3%, Education 2%, Other <1%. 2024 full year (Seyfarth): website accessibility lawsuits at 28% of total ADA Title III caseload.

sources.name: UsableNet — 2025 Midyear Digital Accessibility Lawsuit Report (H1 2025 data)

context: E-commerce has consistently been the top target since 2018. Food service surged as online ordering became mainstream. Healthcare is rising fastest as a percentage — HHS Section 504 digital deadline (May 11, 2026) is driving enforcement attention. One in five of the top 500 e-commerce retailers has already been sued in 2025 (UsableNet midyear 2025).
